arxiv-2108-13846.title: Vector Centrality in Hypergraphs
arxiv-2108-13846.creator: K. Kovalenko, M. Romance, E. Vasilyeva, D. Aleja, R. Criado, D. Musatov, A.M. Raigorodskii, J. Flores, I. Samoylenko, K. Alfaro-Bittner, M. Perc, S. Boccaletti
arxiv-2108-13846.description: Abstract Identifying the most influential nodes in networked systems is of vital importance to optimize their function and control. Several scalar metrics have been proposed to that effect, but the recent shift in focus towards network structures which go beyond a simple collection of dyadic interactions has rendered them void of performance guarantees.

arxiv-2209-00022.title: Nodal higher-order topological superconductivity from a 𝒞 4 \mathcal{C}_{4} -symmetric Dirac semimetal
arxiv-2209-00022.creator: Zhenfei Wu, Yuxuan Wang
arxiv-2209-00022.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Zhenfei Wu, Yuxuan Wang. We analyze the topological properties of the possible superconducting states emerging from a Cd 3 As 2 -like, 𝒞 4 \mathcal{C}_{4} -symmetric Dirac semimetal, with two fourfold-degenerate Dirac points separated in the k z k_{z} direction. Unlike the simplest Weyl semimetal for which all pairing orders are topologically obstructed and nodal, we show that the topological obstruction for pairing in Dirac semimetals crucially only exists for certain pairing symmetries.

arxiv-2210-07432.title: Monte Carlo Augmented Actor-Critic for Sparse Reward Deep Reinforcement Learning from Suboptimal Demonstrations
arxiv-2210-07432.creator: Albert Wilcox, Ashwin Balakrishna, Jules Dedieu, Wyame Benslimane, Daniel S. Brown, Ken Goldberg
arxiv-2210-07432.description: Abstract Providing densely shaped reward functions for RL algorithms is often exceedingly challenging, motivating the development of RL algorithms that can learn from easier-to-specify sparse reward functions. This sparsity poses new exploration challenges. One common way to address this problem is using demonstrations to provide initial signal about regions of the state space with high rewards.

arxiv-2212-04413.title: Search for ultralight dark matter with spectroscopy of radio-frequency atomic transitions
arxiv-2212-04413.creator: Xue Zhang ID, Abhishek Banerjee ID, Mahapan Leyser, Gilad Perez ID, Stephan Schiller ID, Dmitry Budker ID, Dionysios Antypas ID
arxiv-2212-04413.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xue Zhang ID, Abhishek Banerjee ID, Mahapan Leyser, Gilad Perez ID, Stephan Schiller ID, Dmitry Budker ID, Dionysios Antypas ID. The effects of scalar and pseudoscalar ultralight bosonic dark matter (UBDM) were searched for by comparing the frequency of a quartz oscillator to that of a hyperfine-structure transition in 87 Rb, and an electronic transition in 164 Dy.

arxiv-2407-06073.title: Quantum control of ion-atom collisions beyond the ultracold regime
arxiv-2407-06073.creator: Maks Z. Walewski, Matthew D. Frye, Or Katz, Meirav Pinkas, Roee Ozeri, Michał Tomza
arxiv-2407-06073.description: Abstract Tunable scattering resonances are crucial for controlling atomic and molecular systems. However, their use has so far been limited to ultracold temperatures. These conditions remain hard to achieve for most hybrid trapped ion-atom systems—a prospective platform for quantum technologies and fundamental research.

In this study, the ethnic differences in pharmacokinetics and safety of sepiapterin in Japanese and non-Japanese participants and food effects were evaluated.

pmc-12470033.title: The Luminos Project: Co-Designing a Short-Stay Suicide Support Model for Young People
pmc-12470033.creator: Aims Hansen, Samantha Speirs, Kirsten Panton, Jacinta Freeman, Zrinka Highfield, Kieren Marshall, Eleanor Tighe, Laura Hemming, Bep Uink, Francis Mitrou, Vu Vuong, Ashleigh Lin, Paul S Links
pmc-12470033.description: Background: Suicide was the leading cause of death among young Australians aged 15–24 years old in 2023, with 392 lives lost. The continued high numbers of youth suicide demand urgent exploration of alternative approaches to suicide intervention in this population. The United Kingdom-based suicide service Maytree offers an innovative short-term stay for people experiencing suicidal thoughts.

pmc-12588374.title: Predictors of psychological well-being during imposed prolonged absence from work

pmc-12588374.description: BackgroundBetween March 2020 and September 2021, 11.7 million employee jobs were furloughed through the UK Coronavirus Job Retention Scheme (JRS). pmc-13188771.title: The gene mutation pattern of urachal squamous cell carcinoma resembles that of gastrointestinal tumors: a rare case with favorable prognosis following surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy
pmc-13188771.creator: Xiaochun Lu, Xiangyun You, Tao Liu, Yanan Wei, Deming Sun, Cheng Yi, Tan Li, Junfeng Yu, Xiaobo Chen, Zhendong Xiang
pmc-13188771.description: BackgroundUrachal carcinoma (UrC) is a rare epithelial malignant tumor of the urinary system, with an age-standardized incidence of 0.32 per million population, accounting for 0.35–0.70% of all bladder tumors. Adenocarcinoma is the most common histological subtype of UrC, while squamous cell carcinoma is extremely rare, representing only 2% of all UrC cases, and is associated with a high mortality rate.

pmc-13267452.creator: Guido Nador, Rohit Vijjhalwar, Muhammad Kassim Javaid, Claire M. Edwards, Karthik Ramasamy
pmc-13267452.description: SummaryMultiple myeloma (MM) is a haematological malignancy characterised by clonal plasma cell accumulation in the bone marrow, frequently resulting in myeloma bone disease. Disruption of bone homeostasis, driven by increased osteoclastic resorption and suppressed osteoblastic formation, leads to osteolytic lesions and skeletal‐related events, contributing substantially to morbidity and mortality.
